lines.zh: 我走不了，这身绒布钉在座上
lines.en: I cannot walk, this plush is fixed to the seat

lines.zh: 这不是走，只是灯影在晃
lines.en: This is not walking, only the lamp shadow swaying

lines.zh: 有人搬动我，我也只会坐着
lines.en: If someone moves me, I am still sitting

lines.zh: 座子下面是空的，只有一根轴
lines.en: Under the seat there is only an axle

lines.zh: 剧场里没有人，椅子却响
lines.en: The diner is empty, yet a chair creaks

lines.zh: 我不是走过来的，我一直在
lines.en: I did not walk here, I have always been

lines.zh: 要是能站起来，这里就不一样了
lines.en: If I could stand, this place would be different

lines.zh: 蜡一样的眼睛，看着走廊
lines.en: Waxen eyes watching the corridor

lines.zh: 走不了，就等人先走
lines.en: Since I cannot walk, others must walk first

lines.zh: 绒布落了灰，也没人拍
lines.en: Dust settles on the plush and nobody brushes it

lines.zh: 脚是铸死的，地板是旧木
lines.en: My feet are cast solid, the floor is old wood

lines.zh: 一步也没有，可我在动别人的心
lines.en: Not one step, yet I move other people's minds

lines.zh: 我坐着，脊背挺得很直
lines.en: I sit with my spine very straight

lines.zh: 这一坐就是很多年
lines.en: I have been sitting for many years

lines.zh: 绒布的味道，旧得发酸
lines.en: The plush smells old and sour

lines.zh: 眼窝里暗着，没有灯泡
lines.en: The eye sockets are dark, no bulbs in them

lines.zh: 我不会动，可我知道谁经过
lines.en: I do not move, yet I know who passes

lines.zh: 椅子的弹簧早就不行了
lines.en: The chair's springs gave out long ago

lines.zh: 这餐厅的名字，写在我身上
lines.en: The diner's name is written on me

lines.zh: 帽檐歪了一点，没人扶
lines.en: My hat brim is a little askew, nobody fixes it

lines.zh: 我对着门坐，一直对着
lines.en: I face the door, and always have

lines.zh: 有人进来，我的眼睛就跟着
lines.en: When someone enters, my eyes follow

lines.zh: 灰尘在我肩上积了一层
lines.en: Dust has layered on my shoulders

lines.zh: 门铃响过无数次，我都听着
lines.en: That bell has rung countless times, and I heard them all

lines.zh: 坐着，也是一种等
lines.en: Sitting is also a kind of waiting

lines.zh: 楼下有脚步，我不会下楼
lines.en: There are footsteps below, I will not go down

lines.zh: 你站在我面前，正好在光里
lines.en: You stand before me, right in the light

lines.zh: 我的眼睛不会眨，你的会
lines.en: My eyes cannot blink, yours can

lines.zh: 这个位置，是给客人坐的
lines.en: This seat is for customers

lines.zh: 你笑什么，这里不该笑
lines.en: Why do you smile, nobody smiles here

lines.zh: 我看你很久了，你没发现
lines.en: I have watched you a long while, you never noticed

lines.zh: 绒布下面的骨架，你猜有几根
lines.en: How many rods under this plush, would you guess

lines.zh: 别靠太近，这个座子不高
lines.en: Do not lean in, this seat is not tall

lines.zh: 你要坐就坐，别站在这儿挡光
lines.en: Sit if you will, but do not block the light

lines.zh: 我们的脸，是照着人做的
lines.en: Our faces were made to match people

lines.zh: 你走的时候，我会记得方向
lines.en: When you leave, I will remember the direction

lines.zh: 你说话，我听着，我从来不回答
lines.en: Speak, I listen, I never answer

lines.zh: 帽子上写着名字，你可以念
lines.en: There is a name on the hat, you may read it

lines.zh: 这张脸吓过人，也哄过小孩
lines.en: This face has frightened people and soothed children

lines.zh: 你身后那扇门，我看了十年
lines.en: That door behind you, I have watched for ten years

lines.zh: 你的影子刚好落在我膝上
lines.en: Your shadow falls right across my knees

lines.zh: 你站得这么近，是想要什么
lines.en: Standing this close, what is it you want

lines.zh: 绒布摸上去很软，别试
lines.en: The plush is soft to the touch, do not try it

lines.zh: 灯灭了，你还在原地
lines.en: The lights are out, and you are still standing there

lines.zh: 绒布破了一道口
lines.en: A seam has split in the plush

lines.zh: 里面露出来的，不是棉花
lines.en: That is not cotton showing through

lines.zh: 我晃了晃，座子跟着响
lines.en: I rocked and the seat creaked

lines.zh: 你看，我还是没动
lines.en: See, I still have not moved

lines.zh: 这点伤，比坐在这儿好受
lines.en: This wound is easier than sitting here

lines.zh: 我连躲都躲不了
lines.en: I cannot even dodge

lines.zh: 灰尘抖了一地
lines.en: Dust shook loose all over the floor

lines.zh: 眼睛歪了一只
lines.en: One eye has gone crooked

lines.zh: 你想砸烂我，得再来几下
lines.en: You will need more blows to break me

lines.zh: 我还在，椅子也还在
lines.en: I am still here, and so is the chair

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，这嘴是缝的
lines.en: I do not eat, this mouth is sewn shut

lines.zh: 你把东西举给一个摆件
lines.en: You offer food to an ornament

lines.zh: 绒布上没有嘴的位置
lines.en: There is no place for a mouth in this plush

lines.zh: 这味道飘过来，我也闻不到
lines.en: That smell drifts by and I cannot even smell it

lines.zh: 你手别伸进来
lines.en: Do not put your hand in here

lines.zh: 我不会伸手，我的手是缝死的
lines.en: I will not reach out, my hands are stitched shut

lines.zh: 放桌上吧，反正是给客人的
lines.en: Leave it on the table, it is for customers anyway

lines.zh: 这个餐厅早就不营业了
lines.en: This diner closed long ago

lines.zh: 你自己吃，我看着
lines.en: Eat it yourself, I will watch

lines.zh: 别把食物放在我膝盖上
lines.en: Do not put food on my knees

lines.zh: 你撞在座子上，椅子晃了
lines.en: You hit the seat and the chair rocked

lines.zh: 我一动没动，绒布也只是凹了一点
lines.en: I did not move, the plush only dented slightly

lines.zh: 我站不起来，也没法躲
lines.en: I cannot stand, and cannot dodge

lines.zh: 这一下，把灰碰掉了
lines.en: That knocked some dust off

lines.zh: 你要撞就撞，我不会让
lines.en: Ram if you like, I will not give way

lines.zh: 我的底座钉在地板上
lines.en: My base is nailed to the floor

lines.zh: 你退开时踩裂了一块木板
lines.en: You cracked a floorboard when you stepped back

lines.zh: 碰我一下，这地方就记你一笔
lines.en: Touch me once and this place will remember it

lines.zh: 我就坐在这，推也没用。
lines.en: I sit right here, shoving is useless.

lines.zh: 再撞一次，椅子腿就断了
lines.en: Ram again and the chair leg snaps

lines.zh: 我是一个摆件，别开这种玩笑
lines.en: I am a prop, do not make that joke

lines.zh: 绒布下面没有心跳
lines.en: There is no heartbeat under this plush

lines.zh: 这张椅子，只坐得下一个
lines.en: This chair only holds one

lines.zh: 我连转头的余地都没有
lines.en: I do not even have room to turn my head

lines.zh: 你说这些，是忘了我在哪儿
lines.en: Saying that, have you forgotten where I am

lines.zh: 灯光照着，你该走了
lines.en: The light is on you, you should go

lines.zh: 这些话，我听着，不会应
lines.en: I hear such words, and will not answer

lines.zh: 我这一生都坐在这张椅子上
lines.en: I have spent my whole life in this chair

lines.zh: 别把手放在我手上
lines.en: Do not put your hand on mine

lines.zh: 可惜我再也不动了
lines.en: A pity I will never move again

lines.zh: 我抬不起手，也弯不下腰
lines.en: I cannot raise a hand, nor bend at the waist

lines.zh: 东西落在我脚边，我够不着
lines.en: Something fell at my feet, I cannot reach it

lines.zh: 我想要，可我这双手是死的
lines.en: I want it, but these hands are dead

lines.zh: 你捡吧，我看着
lines.en: You pick it up, I will watch

lines.zh: 落在我膝上的东西，也算我的
lines.en: What falls on my knees counts as mine too

lines.zh: 我连手指都弯不了
lines.en: I cannot even curl a finger

lines.zh: 你要拿就拿，别弄倒我
lines.en: Take it, but do not knock me over

lines.zh: 这一片地板都是我的
lines.en: This stretch of floor is mine

lines.zh: 灰落下来，东西就脏了
lines.en: Ash falls and the thing gets dirty

lines.zh: 我看见你捡了
lines.en: I saw you pick it up

lines.zh: 我盯住你了，虽然我动不了
lines.en: I have my eyes on you, though I cannot move

lines.zh: 我的头只能转这么一点
lines.en: My head only turns this far

lines.zh: 你站进我的视线里了
lines.en: You have stepped into my line of sight

lines.zh: 这条走廊，只有我在看
lines.en: I am the only one watching this corridor

lines.zh: 你听见那个声音了吗
lines.en: Did you hear that sound

lines.zh: 一有动静，绒布就绷紧了
lines.en: At any sound, the plush pulls taut

lines.zh: 我的眼窝里没有光，可我在看
lines.en: There is no light in these sockets, yet I see

lines.zh: 你越走近，我越安静
lines.en: The closer you come, the quieter I get

lines.zh: 这地方，进来容易出去难
lines.en: Getting in is easy, getting out is not

lines.zh: 我把你的位置记下了
lines.en: I have your position recorded

lines.zh: 舞台那边有脚步声
lines.en: Footsteps over by the stage

lines.zh: 门刚刚自己关上了
lines.en: The door just shut by itself

lines.zh: 你现在回头，会看见我
lines.en: If you turn now, you will see me

lines.zh: 我不会喊，我叫不出声
lines.en: I will not call out, I have no voice

lines.zh: 有人在这一层走来走去
lines.en: Someone is walking on this floor

lines.zh: 你听见的，不是椅子响
lines.en: What you heard was not a chair

lines.zh: 我一直朝着你的方向
lines.en: I remain turned toward you

lines.zh: 我坐着，你看不出我在等
lines.en: I sit, and you cannot tell I am waiting

lines.zh: 这间屋子的门，只有一个
lines.en: This room has only one door

lines.zh: 灯闪了一下，你还在
lines.en: The light flickered, and you are still here

lines.zh: 墙壁上有我坐了很多年的影子
lines.en: My shadow has sat on this wall for years

lines.zh: 你别往走廊尽头走
lines.en: Do not walk to the end of the corridor

lines.zh: 这个地方，白天也很暗
lines.en: This place is dark even by day

lines.zh: 绒布上的灰在动
lines.en: The dust on the plush is moving

lines.zh: 我坐得越久，越像活着的
lines.en: The longer I sit, the more alive I seem

lines.zh: 你回头的时候，我还在这儿
lines.en: When you look back, I am still here

lines.zh: 椅子底下有东西滚过去
lines.en: Something rolled under the chair

lines.zh: 我不需要站起来
lines.en: I do not need to stand up

lines.zh: 那个人不会走开的
lines.en: That one will not walk away

lines.zh: 你听见音乐了吗
lines.en: Do you hear the music

lines.zh: 门缝里有光，光里有影子
lines.en: Light in the door gap, a shadow in the light

lines.zh: 我的手指，刚才不是这样
lines.en: My fingers were not like this before

lines.zh: 这一片安静得不对
lines.en: This quiet is wrong

lines.zh: 我动不了，可我让空气变冷
lines.en: I cannot move, but I make the air cold

lines.zh: 你感到有人从背后按住你
lines.en: You feel a hand press from behind

lines.zh: 绒布手垂着，没动过
lines.en: The plush hands hang, they have not moved

lines.zh: 这张脸靠近你的时候，不需要走
lines.en: This face comes close without walking

lines.zh: 你被自己的脚步声吓到了
lines.en: Your own footsteps frightened you

lines.zh: 我没有出手，是这地方出的手
lines.en: I did not strike, this place did

lines.zh: 座子一沉，你就退不了
lines.en: The seat sinks and you cannot retreat

lines.zh: 灯光打在你脸上，你闭了眼
lines.en: The light hits your face and you shut your eyes

lines.zh: 我什么都没做，你已经退了
lines.en: I did nothing, and you already backed off

lines.zh: 脖子上有凉气，那是我
lines.en: That chill on your neck is me

lines.zh: 你再靠近，椅子会响
lines.en: Come closer and the chair will creak

lines.zh: 绒布裂了一道口，里面是黑的
lines.en: A seam split in the plush, black inside

lines.zh: 你听见很轻的一声笑
lines.en: You hear a very soft laugh

lines.zh: 我坐在这里，你已经绕不过去
lines.en: I sit here, and you cannot get around me

lines.zh: 这一层楼，都是我的舞台
lines.en: This whole floor is my stage

lines.zh: 餐厅里本来就有我
lines.en: I was always in this diner

lines.zh: 他们把我摆在这儿，就一直摆着
lines.en: They set me here and here I stayed

lines.zh: 灯亮的时候，我在
lines.en: When the lights came on, I was there

lines.zh: 旧木地板响了一声
lines.en: An old floorboard creaked

lines.zh: 我坐在台子旁边，冲着门
lines.en: I sit by the platform, facing the door

lines.zh: 绒布上落了新的灰
lines.en: Fresh dust has settled on the plush

lines.zh: 帽子摆正了，人却不在了
lines.en: The hat is straight, but the people are gone

lines.zh: 这间屋子的气味很旧
lines.en: This room smells very old

lines.zh: 有人掀开了幕布
lines.en: Someone drew back the curtain

lines.zh: 台子上多了一个座位
lines.en: There is one more seat on the platform

lines.zh: 我来的时候，门是开的
lines.en: When I arrived, the door was open

lines.zh: 桌面上的盘子还没收
lines.en: The plates on the table are still out

lines.zh: 我的影子先在墙上
lines.en: My shadow arrives on the wall first

lines.zh: 这地方该有个人坐着
lines.en: Somebody ought to be sitting here

lines.zh: 笑声停了，我还在
lines.en: The laughter stopped, I am still here

lines.zh: 灯管响了一声，就亮了
lines.en: The tube buzzed once and lit

lines.zh: 门上的铃没有再响
lines.en: The bell on the door has not rung again

lines.zh: 今天来的客人，不会走
lines.en: Today's guest will not leave

lines.zh: 绒布烧起来，味道很冲
lines.en: The plush caught fire, the smell is harsh

lines.zh: 我从座子上翻下去，摔了个歪
lines.en: I toppled off the seat and landed askew

lines.zh: 水渗进绒布里，沉得很
lines.en: Water soaked into the plush, it grew heavy

lines.zh: 炸得我半边脸都掉了
lines.en: The blast tore off half my face

lines.zh: 一支箭扎在胸口，扎穿了
lines.en: An arrow went through my chest

lines.zh: 一股力气钻进骨架，骨架在响
lines.en: Something entered the frame, and it groans

lines.zh: 我不会饿，可我很想
lines.en: I cannot starve, yet I wish I could

lines.zh: 雷光把整间屋子照白，我的眼睛亮了
lines.en: The flash whitened the room and my eyes lit up

lines.zh: 这里没有地板，座子也无处安
lines.en: No floor here for the seat to rest on
